name: model-apps
description: Build model-driven Power Apps end to end: /app-builder authors whole apps (tables, relationships, forms, views, charts, security roles, app + sitemap), /genpage builds generative pages, and /pcf builds, tests, deploys and verifies Power Apps component framework (PCF) code components for model-driven apps and Power Pages. Requires Node.js 20+, PAC CLI and Azure CLI (`az`) for live Dataverse operations. See CHANGELOG.md for v1.x -> v2.x migration.
